about.title:
GalaxPlus —
building since 2021
about.text1: GalaxPlus brings together engineers, architects and builders who have spent more than five years setting the turnkey standard in Kyiv: from the first sketch to a fully fitted-out space. We work on housing, offices, retail sites and industrial facilities — and everywhere we follow one principle: complex decisions should be clear to the client.
about.text2: Every project is led by a dedicated manager, and technical supervision is carried out by the specialists who designed and installed those utilities themselves. That is why we spot risks before they arise and deliver a result that matches the design down to the last millimetre.
